MAT.24.19-22.text: Jesus warns of great suffering in those days

MAT.24.23-25.text: Jesus warns the disciples about false Christs and prophets

MAT.24.26-28.text: Jesus says the Son of Man will come like lightning

MAT.24.29-29.text: Jesus says the sun, moon and stars will be shaken

MAT.24.30-31.text: The Son of Man will come and gather his chosen people

MAT.24.32-33.text: Jesus uses the fig tree to teach the disciples about signs

MAT.24.34-35.text: Jesus says these things will happen but his words last

MAT.24.36-36.text: Only the Father knows the day and hour

MAT.24.37-39.text: Jesus compares his coming to the days of Noah

MAT.24.40-42.text: Jesus tells the disciples to keep watch for the Lord

MAT.24.43-44.text: Jesus tells the disciples to be ready like a homeowner

MAT.24.45-47.text: Jesus praises the faithful servant who does his work

MAT.24.48-51.text: Jesus warns about the wicked servant who is punished

MAT.25.1-4.text: Jesus tells of ten virgins, five wise and five foolish

MAT.25.5-6.text: The bridegroom is late and arrives at midnight

MAT.25.7-9.text: The foolish virgins ask for oil, but the wise refuse

MAT.25.10-13.text: The bridegroom comes and the door is shut on five virgins

MAT.25.14-16.text: A man gives talents to his servants before a journey

MAT.25.17-18.text: One servant gains more talents; another hides his talent

MAT.25.19-21.text: The master praises the servant who gained five talents

MAT.25.22-23.text: The master praises the servant who gained two talents

MAT.25.24-25.text: The servant with one talent says he was afraid

MAT.25.26-27.text: The master calls the servant wicked and lazy

MAT.25.28-30.text: The master takes the talent and punishes the servant

MAT.25.31-33.text: The Son of Man will separate the sheep from the goats

MAT.25.34-36.text: The King welcomes those who helped him in need

MAT.25.37-40.text: The King says that helping his brothers is helping him

MAT.25.41-43.text: The King rejects those on his left who did not help

MAT.25.44-46.text: The King sends the two groups to punishment or life

MAT.26.1-2.text: Jesus tells the disciples he will be crucified

MAT.26.3-5.text: The leaders plan to arrest and kill Jesus secretly

MAT.26.6-9.text: A woman pours perfume on Jesus and the disciples object

MAT.26.10-11.text: Jesus says the woman did a beautiful deed

MAT.26.12-13.text: Jesus says the woman prepared his body for burial

MAT.26.20-22.text: Jesus says one of the twelve disciples will betray him

MAT.26.23-25.text: Jesus warns about the betrayer and answers Judas

MAT.26.26-26.text: Jesus gives the disciples bread as his body

MAT.26.27-29.text: Jesus gives the cup as his blood of the covenant

MAT.26.30-30.text: Jesus and the disciples go to the Mount of Olives

MAT.26.31-32.text: Jesus says all the disciples will fall away

MAT.26.33-35.text: Peter promises loyalty; Jesus says Peter will deny him

MAT.26.36-38.text: Jesus is sorrowful and asks Peter and two others to watch

MAT.26.39-41.text: Jesus prays, then finds the disciples asleep

MAT.26.42-44.text: Jesus prays again that God’s will be done

MAT.26.45-46.text: Jesus wakes the disciples because the betrayer is near

MAT.26.47-48.text: Judas comes with a crowd to arrest Jesus

MAT.26.49-50.text: Judas kisses Jesus and the men arrest him

MAT.26.51-54.text: Jesus tells a disciple to put away his sword

MAT.26.55-56.text: Jesus speaks to the crowd and the disciples run away

MAT.26.57-58.text: Jesus is taken to Caiaphas and Peter follows

MAT.26.59-61.text: Leaders look for false witnesses against Jesus

MAT.26.62-64.text: Jesus answers the high priest about being the Christ

MAT.26.65-66.text: The high priest says Jesus blasphemed and deserves death

check.why: The other leaders, not the high priest, declare that Jesus deserves to die.
check.suggestion: The leaders say Jesus blasphemed and deserves to die

MAT.26.67-68.text: The men spit on Jesus, hit him and mock him

MAT.26.69-70.text: A servant girl says Peter was with Jesus; Peter denies it

MAT.26.71-72.text: Peter denies Jesus again with an oath

MAT.26.73-75.text: Peter says he does not know Jesus and weeps

MAT.27.3-5.text: Judas returns the silver and hangs himself

MAT.27.6-8.text: The chief priests buy the potter’s field with the silver

MAT.27.9-10.text: Jeremiah’s words about the thirty silver pieces come true

MAT.27.15-16.text: Pilate had a custom to free one prisoner at the feast

MAT.27.17-19.text: Pilate asks the crowd to choose Barabbas or Jesus

MAT.27.20-22.text: The crowd asks for Barabbas and for Jesus to be crucified

MAT.27.23-23.text: The crowd shouts louder for Jesus to be crucified

MAT.27.24-24.text: Pilate washes his hands and says he is innocent

MAT.27.25-26.text: Pilate frees Barabbas and hands Jesus over to be crucified

MAT.27.27-29.text: The soldiers dress Jesus as a king and mock him

MAT.27.30-31.text: The soldiers spit on Jesus, strike him, and lead him away

MAT.27.32-34.text: Simon carries Jesus’ cross at Golgotha

check.why: Simon carried the cross on the way to Golgotha, not at Golgotha.
check.suggestion: Simon carries Jesus’ cross to Golgotha

MAT.27.35-37.text: Soldiers divide Jesus’ clothes and put up the charge

MAT.27.38-40.text: Two robbers are crucified, and people mock Jesus

MAT.27.41-42.text: The religious leaders mock Jesus on the cross

MAT.27.43-44.text: Leaders and robbers insult Jesus on the cross

MAT.27.45-47.text: Darkness comes, and Jesus cries out to God

MAT.27.48-50.text: Someone gives Jesus sour wine, and Jesus dies

MAT.27.51-53.text: The temple veil tears and the earth shakes

check.why: It only describes verse 51 and omits the tombs opening and the saints being raised in verses 52–53.
check.suggestion: The temple veil tears, and many saints are raised

MAT.27.54-56.text: The centurion says Jesus is the Son of God

MAT.27.57-58.text: Joseph of Arimathea asks Pilate for Jesus’ body

MAT.27.59-61.text: Joseph puts Jesus in his own new tomb

MAT.27.62-64.text: The chief priests ask Pilate to secure the tomb

MAT.27.65-66.text: Pilate allows a guard, and the tomb is sealed

MAT.28.1-2.text: Two women come to the tomb, and an angel opens it

MAT.28.3-4.text: The guards shake with fear of the angel

MAT.28.5-7.text: The angel tells the women that Jesus has risen

MAT.28.8-10.text: Jesus meets the women, who worship him

MAT.28.11-13.text: The chief priests pay the guards to tell a lie

MAT.28.14-15.text: The guards take the money and spread the false story

MAT.28.16-17.text: The eleven disciples see Jesus in Galilee and worship

MAT.28.18-19.text: Jesus tells the disciples to make disciples of all nations

MAT.28.20-20.text: Jesus promises to be with the disciples always
